limitations: Tool observation points differ: Claude pre-tool hook versus Codex terminal turn items. Unknown decisions are not inferred as approvals.
The SDKs do not guarantee identical token accounting. Cache tokens represent cache reads; missing fields remain unavailable.
Claude estimated_cost is SDK-reported and does not establish provider-side subscription billing or an exact charge.
Permission-denial summary events may describe the same operation as a tool decision and must not be added to tool counts.
Brainstorm, Audit and Fleet events are project-scoped because those CLI paths do not create a durable run row.
Live event persistence covers disposable single-surface build and review workflows, not every workflow variant or every failure mode.
